title: Grilled Prawn Skewers with Australian BBQ Sauce
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for grilled prawn skewers, smothered in a sweet and tangy Australian BBQ sauce. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together honey, ketchup, and Australian barbecue sauce.
Brush the skewers with the BBQ sauce mixture.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
